validation_incidents.cause: Generic Read is not Immutable; aggregate initialization introduces a whole-record constructor helper and extra call.
validation_incidents.correction: Assert NONE load flags; initialize fields directly to isolate read/replace/read and the readonly BF3 parameter rejection. Compiler implementation unchanged.

validation_incidents.cause: Direct device/shared element-pointer shapes originally defer recursive raw/sequential classification until second-pass validation; eager recognition could alter malformed-operand diagnostic order.
validation_incidents.correction: Retain deferred direct-result proof in first pass and finish classification at original second-pass position. No tests run against superseded build.

validation_incidents.cause: Fake struct builder accepts only scalar/vector/array children and a single struct field list, rejecting canonical nested Inner inside Payload.
validation_incidents.correction: Reuse existing RealBuilderFakeNVVMLoader for nested records; assert actual LLVM field/index operations, alignment, and absence of invariant metadata in readonly borrow helper. Production compiler unchanged.

validation_incidents.detail: Two new unit assertions required unnecessary whole-array memory operations and ignored an integer conversion before layout-value storage. Retained LLVM/fake operations justified correcting only the tests; corrected units pass.

One resource negative omitted a struct semicolon before its resource declaration. Frontend errors were retained and never counted as role coverage; repaired fixture rejects with the intended E52017 and no provider calls.

Offline DXC auto-detection could not configure a new isolated static build. Disable unused DXIL only in that isolated configuration; local sources and existing NVVM provider then build successfully. Shared acceptance configuration stays unchanged.

validation_incidents.resolution: Exact-file before gates establish five correct and four preflight cells.
